$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the services-emergency pack composed with a water, fire and storm restoration content seed (Bayou Restoration, Houston), re-registered in the stormline register with its own page skeletons. Everything structural — builders, routes, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: Water & storm restoration
description: A storm-restoration dispatch site in harbor blue and amber: the hero is the dispatcher's first question asked over the storm photograph — a "What happened?" intake card (water, fire, storm, mold), a ZIP and a callback number. Under it a navy dispatch board from a real storm night, what happens next in four steps, a before-and-after of one living room, reviews, the neighborhoods, and the call.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed override. resolveCatalog merges a remix's content per-domain over the base's, so this appointments seed replaces the base pack's at compose and mirrors THIS remix's contentSeed module entry for entry (the remix-seed tests pin the twin) — the composed template's booking widget and Manage calendar open on this business's own provider, not the base demo business's.

types.name: Mold inspection & air test
types.description: A visual inspection, moisture mapping and air samples, with a written report in 48 hours.

types.name: Rebuild walkthrough
types.description: After drying: we walk the house with you and scope the rebuild for the claim.

theme.$comment: The stormline register's amber, pinned as the brand so the app surfaces match the marketing pages: the safety amber of the asks and the board's figures, lifted for the night sheet. navigation declares the full-width bar (a declared theme variant outranks the shared shell's split bar): one band across the top with the 24/7 number at its end.

landing.$comment: Doc-aware pack pages: routes maps each pack route to the page id its config merges under (ServicesEmergencyPage.tsx, useSitePageConfig); pages seeds each page's skeleton — ids match servicesEmergencyLanding.ts. The preset is stormline (cool ground, harbor-navy plate, amber signal, Schibsted Grotesk over Public Sans, the dispatch treatment). Home: the intake hero (form-first bound to the storm photograph — the intake card over the scene); the dispatch board (schedule day-rows on the navy plate); what happens next as four cards; one room before and after; reviews; the neighborhoods; the call. The price book and services live on /services.
